name: Book Like A Boss
description_en:
Book Like A Boss is a booking-page builder for appointments, paid services, classes, events and memberships. The recorded booklikeaboss.com site now redirects to blab.co, which presents the same product identity and its Freelancer/Teams offers.

Its distinction is a branded page combining service presentation with booking and, on eligible plans, payment. Selling paid appointments, custom domains and team routing have different entitlements.
description_zh:
Book Like A Boss 是预约页面构建器，覆盖预约、付费服务、课程、活动及会员。记录中的 booklikeaboss.com 当前跳转 blab.co，后者展示同一产品身份及 Freelancer／Teams 方案。

它的特点是把服务展示与预约结合为品牌页面，并在符合条件的套餐开放付款。付费预约、自定义域名及团队分配有不同权益。

core_features.explanation_en: Combine service descriptions, media, FAQs and appointment capture.
core_features.explanation_zh: 结合服务描述、媒体、FAQ 与预约。

core_features.explanation_en: Eligible Freelancer plans support charging, classes and recurring membership offers.
core_features.explanation_zh: 符合条件的 Freelancer 套餐支持收费、课程与周期会员。

core_features.explanation_en: Teams provides round-robin, a directory and team-level reporting.
core_features.explanation_zh: Teams 提供轮转分配、目录与团队报表。

en: Present a service and let a client book/pay from one branded page.
zh: 在同一品牌页面展示服务并让客户预约／付款。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative selection guidance; no customer outcome or hands-on claim.

Deployment.en: Hosted booking pages; recorded official domain redirects to blab.co.
Deployment.zh: 托管预约页面；原官方域名跳转至 blab.co。

steps.en: Choose whether the page only accepts appointments or also charges for services.
steps.zh: 先决定页面仅接受预约，还是也收取服务费用。

steps.en: Build a page, connect the intended calendar/payment account and test the complete handoff.
steps.zh: 建立页面，连接目标日历／支付账户并测试完整交接。

steps.en: Confirm domain, branding, seat/SMS terms and cancellation route on the chosen plan.
steps.zh: 按所选套餐确认域名、品牌、席位／短信条件与取消路径。

items.en: Official cancellation help says Freelancer subscriptions downgrade to Free Boss at the end of the paid term; company-plan cancellation goes through support and confirmation. Deleting the booking page/account also requires support. The continued Free Boss scope is not documented in the public pricing cards, so its availability does not prove a fully featured perpetual free offer for new users. No self-hosted edition or open-source licence was established. Calendar/payment execution, refund handling, downgrade entitlements and data export remain untested.
items.zh: 官方取消帮助说明 Freelancer 在已付周期末降至 Free Boss；公司方案取消需经支持确认。删除预约页／账户也需要支持。公开定价卡片没有说明持续 Free Boss 的功能，因此存在降级路径不能证明新用户有完整永久免费方案。未确认自行托管版或开源许可。日历／支付执行、退款处理、降级权益与数据导出仍未测试。

pricing.billing_basis: Freelancer cadence or Teams seat quote; add-ons separate.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Freelancer monthly $10/$12/$20/$30, annual equivalents $8.33/$10/$16.66/$25. Trial 14 days no card; Teams calculator total unverified; downgrade Free Boss scope unknown.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Freelancer 按月 10／12／20／30 美元，年付月均 8.33／10／16.66／25。无需信用卡试用 14 天；Teams 计算器总额未确认，降级 Free Boss 范围未知。

Historical directory assertions are superseded, including unverified feature and API labels.

sections.title_en: A service page with a booking action
sections.title_zh: 带预约动作的服务页面
sections.en: For an illustrative coaching offer, describe the service, add suitable media/FAQs, connect availability and publish a page or embed it on an existing site. A paid coaching session needs a plan that can charge, plus a supported payment account. Client-facing content is part of the booking flow; page customisation alone does not show that a payment succeeded or a calendar conflict was resolved. Test a free slot, a paid booking and cancellation using representative non-production data.
sections.zh: 例如教练服务可先描述服务、添加合适媒体／FAQ、连接可用时间，再发布页面或嵌入已有网站。付费辅导需要可收费套餐与支持的支付账户。客户看到的内容属于预约流程的一部分；页面可定制本身不证明付款成功或日历冲突已解决。应使用代表性非正式数据测试免费时段、付费预约及取消。

sections.title_en: Free appointments are not a free platform plan
sections.title_zh: 免费预约不等于平台免费套餐
sections.en: The Freelancer page lists monthly Espresso $10, Mocha $12, Cappuccino $20 and Latte $30, with annual equivalents $8.33/$10/$16.66/$25 per month. Espresso is positioned for appointments without charging clients. Cappuccino adds paid bookings/classes/memberships, but its card explicitly excludes custom domain/branding removal despite inherited-feature wording; Latte combines selling and those branding features. Confirm checkout entitlements. The service advertises a 14-day no-card trial and zero platform sales commission; processor fees are a separate question.
sections.zh: Freelancer 页列按月 Espresso 10、Mocha 12、Cappuccino 20、Latte 30，年付折算月价 8.33／10／16.66／25。Espresso 面向不向客户收费的预约。Cappuccino 增加付费预约／课程／会员，但卡片尽管有继承功能措辞，仍明确排除自定义域名／移除品牌；Latte 结合销售及这些品牌能力。需在结账确认权益。服务宣传 14 天无需信用卡试用、平台销售佣金为零；支付渠道费是另一问题。

sections.title_en: Routing and add-ons need a seat quote
sections.title_zh: 分配与附加包需要席位报价
sections.en: Teams adds round-robin assignment, a team page, member directory, team reports and company/member payment choices. The calculator shows $8.50 USD/month with a user slider and cadence control, but the retrieved view does not unambiguously bind a payable total to a seat/cadence selection. Teams Pro is stated as an extra $5/month/seat, including branding removal and SMS allowance increasing from 100 to 200 per seat. Do not quote the calculator amount as a complete team bill.
sections.zh: Teams 增加轮转分配、团队页、成员目录、团队报表及公司／成员收款选择。计算器在用户滑块和账期控制旁显示每月 8.50 美元，但读取内容未把实际总价与席位／账期选择明确绑定。Teams Pro 写明额外每席位每月 5 美元，包含移除品牌及每席短信额度从 100 增至 200。不能把计算器金额当作完整团队账单。

sections.en: Official cancellation help says Freelancer subscriptions downgrade to Free Boss at the end of the paid term; company-plan cancellation goes through support and confirmation. Deleting the booking page/account also requires support. The continued Free Boss scope is not documented in the public pricing cards, so its availability does not prove a fully featured perpetual free offer for new users. No self-hosted edition or open-source licence was established. Calendar/payment execution, refund handling, downgrade entitlements and data export remain untested.

research_gaps.en: Freelancer card inheritance conflicts, actual Teams quote, Free Boss eligibility/features, processor fees, export and live recovery were not tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试 Freelancer 卡片继承冲突、实际 Teams 报价、Free Boss 资格／功能、支付渠道费、导出及真实恢复。
